headline: Meta puts incrementality in Ads Manager, and Google turns on video by default: check your measurement and placements today.

items.title: Fixture: Meta adds incrementality reporting to Ads Manager for all advertisers
items.summary: Meta is rolling out a built-in conversion lift view in Ads Manager, so advertisers can see estimated incremental conversions next to attributed results without a separate study.

performance.soWhat: Compare attributed vs incremental CPA on your top campaigns this week before you shift budget.

ua.soWhat: Use lift results to sanity-check app install campaigns that look strong on last-click.

brand.soWhat: Useful proof for upper-funnel spend when finance asks what brand campaigns really drive.

items.title: Fixture: Google Ads makes Demand Gen video placements default for new campaigns
items.summary: New Demand Gen campaigns will include YouTube Shorts and in-stream placements by default, with an opt-out per channel at the ad group level.

performance.soWhat: Check new Demand Gen campaigns for video spend you did not plan for; add exclusions if needed.

ua.soWhat: Shorts inventory can be cheap reach for app campaigns; give it a separate budget test.

brand.soWhat: You now need vertical video for every Demand Gen launch; brief the creative team.

items.title: Fixture: Why your attribution model is quietly overpaying for retargeting
items.summary: An argument that view-through and short-window retargeting take credit for conversions that would have happened anyway, with a simple holdout test to check.

performance.soWhat: Run a 10% retargeting holdout for two weeks; cut spend if the gap is small.

ua.soWhat: Re-engagement campaigns have the same problem; holdouts apply to apps too.

brand.soWhat: A reminder to judge brand work on reach and recall, not last-touch credit.

items.title: Fixture: Retail media budgets keep growing as CPMs on the open web slide
items.summary: Agency planners say retail media now takes a larger share of incremental budgets, while open-web CPMs fell for a third straight quarter.

performance.soWhat: Expect cheaper open-web inventory; test prospecting there while CPMs stay soft.

ua.soWhat: Retail media rarely drives installs; keep it out of your UA plan for now.

brand.soWhat: Retail networks are now a brand channel; ask for reach and frequency, not just ROAS.

items.title: Fixture: Connected TV ad spend passes linear for the first time in one US market study
items.summary: A US market study reports connected TV now outspends linear TV for the brands it tracks, driven by streaming ad tiers and programmatic buying.

performance.soWhat: CTV is becoming measurable enough to test with conversion goals; start with a small pilot.

ua.soWhat: CTV can work for app awareness, but install attribution is still weak.

brand.soWhat: Plan TV and streaming as one video budget and compare reach across both.

items.title: Fixture: Apple expands Search Ads to two more App Store placements
items.summary: Apple is adding sponsored results to more App Store surfaces, giving app marketers more paid inventory beyond the search results page.

performance.soWhat: Only relevant if you run app campaigns alongside web.

ua.soWhat: New placements usually launch with low competition; set up a separate campaign to test early CPIs.

brand.soWhat: More paid App Store real estate means organic brand presence matters less on its own.
